data.title: Azura Residences
data.about:
Azura Residences by IGO (Invest Group Overseas) is a stunning collection of 148 beautifully appointed residences that draws inspiration from its waterfront location. Blue water and sky frame the view. It is a tranquil sanctuary, yet just moments from the vibrant heart of Dubai. Not just the best of both worlds, it is home to infinite possibility.

A stunning set of exclusive 1 to 3 Bedroom Apartments and 2 to 3 Bedroom Penthouses + private pools with a waterfront location, in the tranquil yet vibrant Dubai Islands. Azura’s stunning frontage and arrival lobby hint at the impeccable standards awaiting every resident. It is symbolic of the building’s scale and stature and reflective of its organic connection to the natural wonders of sky and sea. Clean lines and generous spaces define every Azura residence. 

The beautifully understated design allows the waterfront location to take centre stage. Serenity is everywhere, both inside and out. Inspired by the locality, the carefully considered colours and textures are timeless and have a distinctive sense of place. Every detail considered and curated. Sumptuous fabrics, cool stone and decadent detailing combine to complement and connect with the landscape beyond your balcony.

characteristics_module.title: Become One with the Sea at Azura Residences
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Porcelain tile floor finishing throughout all living areas, enhancing durability and aesthetics.
  • Fully porcelain-tiled bathrooms, ensuring a sleek and modern look.
  • Vanity units featuring porcelain countertops and mirrors for a luxurious touch.
  • Wall-mounted WC, under-counter wash basins, and European-branded mixers for superior quality.
  • Built-in European-branded appliances including microwave, hob, oven, refrigerator, and a free-standing washing machine.
  • HPL kitchen cabinets with porcelain countertops, offering both style and functionality.
  • Built-in wardrobes with a high-quality finish, providing ample storage space.
  • Wooden doors with a veneer finish, adding a touch of elegance.
  • Smart home system for modern, convenient living.
  • European-made thermal break aluminum sections with double-glazed windows for energy efficiency and comfort.
  • High-quality painted walls, ensuring a pristine and lasting finish.

location_tile.title: A Secluded Oasis at Dubai Islands
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Islands, a sophisticated archipelago, is rapidly becoming a hallmark of luxury living and top-tier hospitality. Residents of Azura Residences by IGO will relish stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, Blue Flag beaches, wellness hubs, eco-friendly spaces, and premium golf courses. With direct mainland access by road and sea, Azura Residences by IGO location offers the perfect balance of seclusion and connectivity, creating a serene oasis to spend quality time with loved ones.

Azura Residences by Invest Group Overseas is situated in a prime spot within this vibrant tourism and business hub. The strategic location, along with luxurious amenities and stunning surroundings, makes IGO Azura Residences Apartments an ideal choice for those seeking waterfront living and investment opportunities. IGO Azura Residences Dubai offers meticulously designed floor plans and attractive payment plans, making it an excellent option for discerning buyers. Discover the apartments for sale at IGO Azura Residences Dubai Islands and experience the epitome of luxury living.

  • 3 Mins to Souk Al Marfa Mall
  • 6 Mins to Dubai Islands Beach
  • 8 Mins to Hamriya Park
  • 8 Mins to Green Leaves Early Childhood Center
  • 13 Mins to Dubai International Airport
  • 27 Mins to Downtown Dubai
